attchmntText: Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication on Unadited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited submitted newspaper cuttings of its un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 520.61 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 846.95 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 734.91 lakhs, versus 851.04 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share for the quarter were 0.16. AvenuesAI Limited also reported un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The company recorded a net profit of 247.4 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 309.7 million in the same period last year. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 501.8 million, versus 676.5 million in the previous year. Earnings per share for the quarter were 0.71. Additionally, Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited issued a public notice for the e-auction of an immovable property in Surat, with a reserve price of 30,00,000 rupees. The auction is scheduled for November 27, 2026.
